the kiwix-apple build is not a plain xcodebuild at any revision: no xcodeproj is committed, so XcodeGen, localizations.py and a curl of the pinned libkiwix xcframework tarball must run first. Those steps are recorded from project.yml and the Brewfile at each affected revision but none of them has been executed

the dimeApp DataController installs NSPersistentCloudKitContainerOptions for a fixed iCloud container and calls fatalError when the store fails to load, so it is not yet established that the application launches at all from an unsigned simulator build. This is the single highest risk in the two new applications and must be settled before either dimeApp candidate is promoted

no candidate has been built. Every simulatorBuildWithoutSigning entry is an inspection of project settings and the entitlements file at the affected revision, not an executed xcodebuild, so buildQualified is null for the whole pool

the count gap is closed but the proof is not. The Aidoku settings freeze candidate and the isowords candidate were both dropped, and kiwix/kiwix-apple and rafsoh/dimeApp were added with two verified pairs each, so eight defects now stand across five independent applications: damus two, Aidoku one, IceCubesApp one, kiwix-apple two and dimeApp two. No application supplies more than a quarter of the selection and the pool keeps a margin of three over the two Stable requires. What is still missing is that neither replacement has been built, and each carries a specific launch risk, XcodeGen plus a fetched libkiwix xcframework for kiwix-apple and an unconditional CloudKit container for dimeApp, so the effective proven coverage remains zero applications

the largest and most rigorously maintained iOS codebases in this space are not SwiftUI-driven at their candidate revisions. wikipedia-ios, firefox-ios, Signal-iOS and KeePassium were each rejected on a per-revision framework check, and wikipedia-ios additionally has GitHub issues disabled, so no issue-linked pair can ever be derived there. The qualifying pool is therefore small independent applications, which is the structural reason this target's inventory is thin
